Level lacks explicit shared floor binding

the World view must exist before BindLevel is called

requirements.issue: Level and Ground must share the same observed global operand cells
requirements.fix: build the ground owner first and use ground.Context.IntersectionOperands.Geometry for the floor operands

why_it_matters: This overturns the earlier conclusion that no real-ground intersection could be produced. A hit is achievable offline with a synthetic 2x2 flat ground and six explicit publications.
boundaries: The hit is against a synthetic flat 2x2 ground chunk, not a loaded map.
No widget, input event, camera, portal or native Engine initialization is involved.
The distance is asserted ordered and positive; it is not compared with a native value.
This test is not part of any frozen recipe yet.
